# Top Hat

> > Top Hat is a higher education technology platform providing interactive teaching tools, digital textbooks, and student engagement solutions for college and university instructors.

The site features insights on active learning, remote teaching strategies, student engagement research, and educational technology trends. Top Hat serves colleges and universities with attendance tracking, real-time feedback systems, and interactive course materials while supporting faculty through pandemic-era transitions and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Higher education technology
- Student engagement
- Active learning
- Remote teaching and learning
- COVID-19 impact on education
- Interactive textbooks
- Classroom technology
- Teaching strategies
- Real-time feedback
- Attendance tracking
- Academic integrity and cheating prevention
- Blended learning
- Faculty development
- Educational research and surveys
- STEM education

## COVID-19 and Remote Learning

- [3,052 College Students On What They Want When Campuses Re-Open](https://tophat.com/blog/student-survey-spring-2021): Student survey on campus reopening expectations and flexible delivery
- [Lessons From a Year of Pandemic Learning: Survey of 3,052 Higher Ed Students Reveals Their Expectations for Instruction and Educational Value in the Fall 2021 Academic Term](https://tophat.com/press-releases/lessons-from-pandemic-learning-survey): 3,052 student survey on pandemic learning and Fall 2021 expectations
- [How COVID-19 May Forever Change the Way Professors Teach](https://tophat.com/blog/how-covid-19-may-forever-change-the-way-professors-teach): COVID-19's lasting impact on teaching methods and blended learning
- [Results from Top Hat's COVID-19 Faculty Survey About Online Teaching](https://tophat.com/news/results-from-top-hats-covid-19-faculty-survey-about-online-teaching): Faculty survey reveals dissatisfaction with Fall 2020 online teaching plans
- [Colleges Can Turn Classes Into Virtual Communities. Here's How.](https://tophat.com/news/colleges-can-turn-classes-into-virtual-communities-heres-how): Building virtual communities and student engagement during COVID-19
- [5 Essential Strategies for Creating Collaborative Remote Classrooms](https://tophat.com/blog/5-essential-strategies-for-creating-collaborative-remote-classrooms): 5 strategies for collaborative learning in remote teaching environments
